row_field_resolution: Each canonical entry is merged by key with row_evidence and the explicitly enumerated shared_row_fields below; together they form the frozen 19-row readiness record.

shared_row_fields.merchant_scope: current authenticated merchant only; tenant-owned models retain BelongsToMerchant scope
shared_row_fields.branch_scope: assigned Front Office branch only; branch-owned models retain BelongsToBranch scope and foreign ULIDs fail closed
shared_row_fields.mfa_step_up: no new operational step-up invented; only the account page manages the signed-in user's own MFA enrollment
shared_row_fields.planned_light_theme: warm light canvas, deep-brown Servana hero, white raised task surfaces and semantic status accents
shared_row_fields.planned_dark_theme: deep-navy canvas and raised surfaces, preserved Servana brown hero, semantic borders and high-contrast text
shared_row_fields.responsive_strategy: CSS-only mobile drawer at <=767, tablet rail at 768–1024, persistent grouped sidebar at >=1025; content stacks before it compresses
shared_row_fields.final_visual_acceptance_source: page-visual-acceptance.json plus hashed light/dark screenshots and focused Playwright evidence
